test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 18 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which one of the following states has the highest length of railway lines in kilometers?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Uttar Pradesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indian Railways**

 
 
• **It is the lifeline of the nation providing transportation facilities over the length and breadth of the country. **
 
• Its vision is to provide efficient, affordable, customer-focused, environmentally sustainable integrated transportation solutions and to be the vehicle of inclusive growth, connecting regions, communities, ports and centres of industry, commerce, tourism and pilgrimage across the country.
 
• **As of 31.03.2020, the route length of Indian Railways covered 67,956 km with a running track length of 99,235 km.**
 
• The total trackage including yards, sidings etc. stood at 1,26,366 km. 
 
• In India, the largest route kilometers are in Uttar Pradesh with 8726 kilometers. This comes out to be 13.6% of India’s total Route Kilometers. The Five states with the largest route kilometres are as follows:
 
• **Uttar Pradesh: 8,808. Hence, Option 2 is correct.**
 
• Rajasthan: 5,998
 
• Maharashtra: 5,829 
 
• Gujarat: 5,301 
 
• Andhra Pradesh: 3,965 ​
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• The **first railway line in India was opened for public traffic on 16 April 1853 between Mumbai and Thane over a distance of 34 km.**
 
• Meanwhile, the construction of the railway lines was going on in the eastern part of the country, and the first section of the East Indian Railway, from **Howrah to Hugli**, **a distance of 37 km was inaugurated on 15 August 1854.**
